$comment: Herramientas de Open Edit Video y sus valores de partida. La interfaz de cada una vive en components/panels.tsx; secondsPer5s es el tiempo aproximado en Comfy Cloud para 5 s de video.

tools.name: Reframe
tools.short: Change the shape. Keep your footage.
tools.tagline: Change the shape of your video. Your footage stays as it is; the AI only paints the new space.

tools.name: Remove
tools.tagline: Click what should disappear. SAM 3 finds it and follows it through the clip; LTX repaints only that area, so the rest of the shot stays exactly as it was.

tools.name: Smooth Cut
tools.short: Cut the pauses. Hide the jumps.
tools.tagline: Cut the pauses out of someone talking, and blend each cut so it doesn't jump.

tools.name: Upscale
tools.tagline: Make your video bigger and sharper, up to 4K.

tools.name: Remove background
tools.short: Your subject on a flat color.
tools.tagline: Put the subject on a flat color, ready to drop onto any background.
